signal: NetBrain launched Agentic NetOps in its 12.3 release, the first major update under new CEO Bernadette Nixon, with AI agents that diagnose and remediate networks

email.body1:
Qi, saw NetBrain ship Agentic NetOps in 12.3, the first big release under your new CEO.

A launch like that puts a lot of enterprise NetOps buyers in-market at once, usually more than the team can cover before the window closes, and POCs stack up faster than reps can work them. Our AI SDR researches, writes, and follows up autonomously, so coverage scales without new headcount: 3-5x more meetings per rep.

I built a personalized signal play for NetBrain off your hiring and tech-stack signals, and accounts showing them tend to progress ~4.4x faster. Worth 15 minutes to walk you through it?
email.body2:
Qi, quick follow-up for NetBrain.

A new agentic release spikes interest, but most teams can't tell how many of those accounts they're actually touching, so it converts at a fraction of its potential. The gap shows up after the launch buzz fades.

Want to grab 15 minutes? I'll walk you through our pipeline model and show exactly how many meetings NetBrain needs to turn 12.3 momentum into target this quarter, and where the math breaks if you only add reps.
email.body3:
Qi, last bit of proof for NetBrain.

Memgraph had more in-market accounts than the team could touch and couldn't hire SDRs fast enough. They ran our AI SDR to $2.7M in pipeline, 600 replies, and 60 BANT-qualified deals in 90 days, same team, live in four weeks, every email auto-logged to their CRM.

I pulled a benchmark of how NetBrain's reply rate likely compares to peer network-software teams. Want to hop on a quick call and I'll walk you through it?
email.body4:
Qi, I'll stop reaching out on this one, but didn't want to leave you empty-handed.

If scaling pipeline without adding headcount isn't a priority this quarter, no problem at all. Launching a major release under a new CEO is its own kind of busy, and timing matters.

Before I close your file, worth 15 minutes to walk through a one-page playbook of three AI-SDR plays scoped to a network-software motion? I'll tailor it to NetBrain either way.
